title: A Riesz-Medvedev Stieltjes Integral Method and Nearness Principle for Solvability of Fractional Integral Equations
content:
A Riesz-Medvedev type of total variation method is employed to study solvabil- 1
ity of quadratic Voltera-Stieltjes integral equations. This solvability method is then shown 2
to be an invaluable approach to the solvability of a very general class of fractional dynamic 3
problems and other singular integral equations. We have given several illustrative exam- 4
ples to coroborate known solvabilty cases for particular fractional and singular integral 5
equations in literature.
